rule: Split on runs of ASCII whitespace [ \t\n\v\f\r] only. Strip leading ([{"'`< and trailing )]}.,;:"'`> characters. Quotes are delimiters matched across tokens: a token's stripped front quotes open (push, left to right); its stripped back quotes, read left to right (innermost first), each close the most recent matching open quote, else they are stray; a token that is only punctuation, while a quote is open, closes with its quotes instead of opening. A token cites a file only when no quote was open before it, none is open after it, and none of its quotes was stray. The rest must start with / and fullmatch /[A-Za-z0-9._~+@%=/-]+? then .SUFFIX, then optionally :LINE or :LINE:COL with ASCII digits. A /./ or /../ segment rejects it. Text suffixes (served by /api/evidence): log txt md py json jsonl toml yaml yml cfg ini xml. Image suffixes (page links only): png webp jpg jpeg. A path cited twice keeps its first spelling. Quotes never span two texts.
